# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Müra testígua tayhi Ancoré bedea devena büra odonai inâjásita bũi cavarai carea y bũi carea triabaya.
Müra testígua nahua enda fuerza nee bümina y büra necea bümina, pohre bümina y büra nejomá iri bümina, Dayhi Ancorea abábüri bũi úmera neea, Tayhi cará büvarina büra y nungamagitaquébmira Viro. Pineaquékuadlin Buisama quentequi bai.
